xBRIEFInfo.description: Story xBRIEF for #2791 — cached task check must not shell internal Taskfile shims.

plan.title: bug(check): #1713 cached task check shells internal Taskfile shims (go-task 202)

narratives.Description: After #1713, framework `task check` shells each FRAMEWORK_CHECK_GATES entry by name. Three Taskfile shims are internal:true and go-task 3.50 exits 202 when invoked directly, blocking release prep.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Change gate-lists to use public verify:wip-cap --allow-over-cap and eval-relocation --base-ref origin/master. 2. Teach cached-orchestrator to spawn CheckGateSpec args after --. 3. Unit test + CHANGELOG. 4. Re-run task check.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer running task check on master, I want the #1713 cached orchestrator to invoke public Taskfile surfaces so go-task does not refuse internal shim names.

items.title: Framework gate list uses public surfaces

narrative.Acceptance: Given FRAMEWORK_CHECK_GATES, when resolved, then it does not contain internal shim task names and WIP-cap/eval-relocation entries carry the shim CLI flags.

expected_outputs: Public gate spawn args; no internal shim names in FRAMEWORK_CHECK_GATES
